svg.title: Stack layout before and after a buffer overflow
svg.desc: Left: normal stack with input inside buf. Right: overflowed stack where the return address is overwritten to point into a NOP sled leading to shellcode. Bottom: the four-step attack path.

g.text: 正常输入，不超过 64 字节

svg.text: 红色：被覆盖的控制数据；黄色：攻击者注入的数据；细箭头：输入填充方向
